user.description: Enter your printer's IP address or hostname (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or printer.local). Names are resolved with whatever DNS/mDNS your Home Assistant host has. Turn on LAN Mode on the printer first.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enable LAN Mode
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer reach {host} over LAN Mode — the printer may have switched back to cloud mode. Turn LAN Mode back on at the printer, then submit.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer. Check the IP and that LAN Mode is on.
error.wrong_printer: That address belongs to a different printer.

print_file.name: Print a file
print_file.description: Sends a sliced file to a printer and starts it.

file.name: File
file.description: A .gcode, .gcode.3mf or sliced .3mf file, up to 100 MB.

allow_clear_bed.name: Cool the bed when done
allow_clear_bed.description: Ends the print parked with the fans on, finishes it once the bed has cooled, and tells you. Kobra S1 Max only.

skip_purge_line.name: Skip the purge line
skip_purge_line.description: Leaves out the line of filament laid at the back of the bed before the print. The very start of the first layer may come out a little thin.

print_again.name: Print again
print_again.description: Starts the last file sent from Home Assistant again.

allow_clear_bed.name: Cool the bed when done
allow_clear_bed.description: Not available for Print again. Send the file again to use it.

clear_bed.name: Clear the bed
clear_bed.description: Pushes a finished print off the bed and out of the open door. Never call this from an automation.

door_open_confirmed.name: Door is open
door_open_confirmed.description: Your confirmation that the printer door is open. Needed when no door sensor is set up.

unknown_printer.message: Choose an Anycubic printer that is set up in Home Assistant.

model_not_enabled.message: Printing from Home Assistant is not available for this printer model yet.

printer_unreachable.message: Home Assistant has not heard from the printer for over a minute. Check that it is on and connected.

submit_in_progress.message: A file is already being sent to this printer. Wait for it to finish.

printer_busy.message: The printer is busy. Try again when the current job ends.

bed_not_clear.message: Clear the bed, then press "Bed is clear".

file_missing.message: The file is no longer available. Choose it again.

file_unreadable.message: The file could not be read. Choose it again.

file_type_not_supported.message: Only .gcode, .gcode.3mf and sliced .3mf files can be printed.

file_name_marked.message: The file name contains "-ha-pushoff", which is reserved. Rename the file and send it again.

file_name_invalid.message: The file name has no usable characters. Rename the file and send it again.

file_empty.message: The file is empty. Export it from the slicer again.

file_too_large.message: The file is larger than 100 MB.

archive_invalid.message: The 3MF file could not be read. Export it from the slicer again.

archive_too_large.message: The 3MF file is too large to check once unpacked.

not_sliced.message: The 3MF file is not sliced. Slice it and export the sliced file.

multi_plate.message: The 3MF file holds more than one plate. Export a single plate.

wrong_printer_model.message: The file was sliced for a different printer. Slice it for this printer.

filament_unknown.message: The printer has not reported its filament yet. Try again in a minute.

multi_filament_needs_unit.message: The file uses more than one filament. Attach an ACE, or slice the file for one filament.

second_unit_single_only.message: With a second ACE attached, only single-filament files can be printed for now.

slot_out_of_range.message: The file uses slot {slot}, which the ACE does not have.

slot_material_unknown.message: The material in slot {slot} is not known. Load the filament or set its type on the printer.

spool_material_unknown.message: The material on the external spool is not known. Load the filament or set its type on the printer.

slot_material_mismatch.message: Slot {slot} holds {loaded}, but the file needs {wanted}. Load {wanted} in slot {slot}, or slice the file for {loaded}.

spool_material_mismatch.message: The external spool holds {loaded}, but the file needs {wanted}. Load {wanted}, or slice the file for {loaded}.

nothing_to_print_again.message: No file has been sent from Home Assistant yet.

print_again_marked.message: The last file is a push-off copy. Send the original file again.

printer_not_answering.message: The printer did not answer. Check that it is on and LAN Mode is on.

upload_refused.message: The printer refused the upload. Check that LAN Mode is on.

upload_not_understood.message: The printer could not read the upload. Send the file again.

upload_not_saved.message: The printer could not save the file. Send the file again.

upload_no_space.message: The printer does not have enough free space for this file. Delete files on the printer, then send it again.

upload_3mf_refused.message: The printer could not read this 3MF file. Export it from the slicer again.

purge_not_found.message: No purge line was found in this file to skip. Turn Skip the purge line off and send it again.

upload_name_changed.message: The printer kept the file under another name, so it was not started. Rename the file and send it again.

upload_failed.message: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and send the file again.

printer_not_connected.message: Home Assistant is not connected to the printer right now. Try again in a minute.

start_refused.message: The printer did not start the print: {reason}.

print_again_refused.message: The printer did not start the last file: {reason}. Send the file again.

start_unconfirmed.message: The printer did not confirm the start. The job may still start, because large 3MF files take time to unpack.

clear_while_busy.message: Wait until the printer is on and idle, then press "Bed is clear".

clear_model.message: Clear the bed is only available for the Kobra S1 Max.

clear_file_model.message: The file does not say which printer it was sliced for, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed. Slice it for this printer.

clear_brim.message: The print has a brim, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed. Slice it without a brim.

clear_skirt.message: The print has a skirt, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed. Slice it without a skirt.

clear_tower.message: The print has a prime tower, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_raft.message: The print has a raft, or does not say whether it has one, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_own_pause.message: The file has a pause of its own, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_bed_not_heated.message: The file does not heat the bed, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_end_code.message: The end of the file was not recognized, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_no_outline.message: The file does not give the outline of its parts, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed. Turn on object labeling in the slicer.

clear_no_height.message: The file does not give the height of its parts, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_unreadable.message: The file could not be checked for Clear the bed. Print it without Allow Clear the bed.

clear_material.message: Clear the bed is only for PLA and PETG.

clear_petg_plate.message: PETG can only be cleared from a textured plate. Slice the file for the textured plate.

clear_part_off_bed.message: A part reaches past the edge of the bed, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_part_too_short.message: The print is too short to be pushed off. Print it without Allow Clear the bed.

clear_part_too_tall.message: The print is taller than 200 mm, so Clear the bed cannot be allowed.

clear_part_too_far_back.message: A part sits too close to the back of the bed to be pushed off. Move it forward in the slicer.

clear_out_of_reach.message: The print cannot be pushed off within the printer's reach. Print it without Allow Clear the bed.

print_again_no_clear.message: Send the file again with Cool the bed when done turned on.

clear_needs_user.message: Clear the bed must be pressed by a person. It cannot be run by an automation or a script.

clear_not_ready.message: There is no finished print waiting to be cleared.

clear_window_over.message: It is too late to clear this print. Press Stop, then clear the bed by hand.

clear_door_closed.message: The door is not open. Open it, then press Clear the bed.

clear_door_not_opened.message: The door has not been opened since the print finished. Open it, then press Clear the bed.

clear_no_door_sensor.message: No door sensor is set up. Use Clear the bed on the dashboard, which asks you to confirm the door is open.

clear_bed_hot.message: The bed is {temp} °C. Wait until it is {limit} °C or cooler.

clear_chamber_hot.message: The chamber is {temp} °C. Wait until it is {limit} °C or cooler.

clear_reading_missing.message: The printer has not reported its temperatures. Try again in a moment.

resume_locked.message: This pause can only be continued with Clear the bed. To end the print without clearing, press Stop.
